flows.name: First course and material
steps: SOURCE choose files, paste text or note
flows.recovery: Canceled add returns to intact empty/course home; failed import retains original with Retry

flows.name: Repeat and batch import
steps: Select multiple permitted files or paste text
flows.exit: SOURCE with per-item status or READ
flows.recovery: Cancel one job without canceling completed items; preserve updated source versions

flows.name: Correct extraction
flows.recovery: Interrupted edit reopens draft; old source and unaffected activities retained

flows.name: Study a passage
flows.recovery: Provider outage retains response; prepared activities remain usable offline; uncertain feedback labeled

flows.name: Listen and ask
flows.recovery: Permission denied offers typing; stop releases capture; network loss preserves question and cached playback

flows.name: PQP practice and rehearsal
steps: Write own Praise, Question and Polish
flows.recovery: No microphone offers typed practice; missing duration stays unconfigured; never generate outline/citations

flows.name: Interrupt and resume
steps: Save progress continuously with visible state
HOME shows Continue where you stopped
flows.recovery: Invalid saved location offers original/source list and retained draft; no duplicate credit

flows.name: Prepare and use offline
flows.recovery: Incomplete assets remain Not ready; cloud tutor unavailable; queued jobs never look complete

flows.name: Inspect course rule conflict
steps: Choose applicable version or leave unresolved
flows.recovery: No invented deadlines, speech lengths or rubric details; user can import more evidence later

flows.name: Backup and restore
flows.exit: Restored course collection or saved backup
flows.recovery: Corruption or interruption retains existing data and gives a specific retry path

flows.name: Review progress
steps: Distinguish reading completed from recalled correctly
flows.recovery: Missing sessions do not create punitive streak state; no mastery from time alone

flows.name: Adjust access and context
flows.exit: Prior task or other course HOME
flows.recovery: Undo preference or return; no wrong-course tutor context; keyboard and text routes always available
